findingClass: a committed test fixture (HTML/JSON/TXT/PNG under scraper/tests/fixtures/** or scraper/tests/unit/pipeline-stages/fixtures/**) has no recorded source URL/capture date, or an HTML fixture's own embedded company name (its <title>/<h1>) disagrees with the company its filename claims — so the fixture silently backs a test with the WRONG page and the test still passes
githubIssue: T-518, 2026-09-08: PR #425 shipped scraper/tests/fixtures/historical/vikran-engineering-cg-detail.html whose own <title> read "Neochem Bio IPO..."; a test asserting "Vikran Engineering -> Specialty Chemicals" against it PASSED. Nothing in CI could catch it — a human caught it by opening the file.
failThreshold: any fixture data file under the two fixture roots with no sibling <file>.meta.json (sourceUrl + capturedAt + company|pageType:true), OR an HTML fixture whose filename claims a company (per the whitelist-strip rule in scripts/lib/fixture-provenance-checks.mjs) and whose extractable <title>/<h1> names a DIFFERENT company, that is not grandfathered in the shrink-only config/fixture-provenance-baseline.json
unverifiableWhen: never — this is a static, deterministic file-content check with no external dependency (no network call, no DB)
wiredInto: pr-gate.yml step "Fixture provenance gate (T-518)" — node scripts/ci/require-fixture-provenance.mjs — runs on every PR (NOT the nightly scripts/audit-detection-floor.mjs — this is a static repo-content gate, not a live-data audit)
